result.description: Portable display hub for creative workstations and conference kits. Features dual USB-C input support, one HDMI 2.0 output, integrated KVM switching, and a compact aluminum enclosure. Designed to extend a laptop into a multi-screen desk setup with low-latency video pass-through and bus-powered operation. Includes status LEDs, anti-slip feet, and a 1.2 m braided cable.
